atlasPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square 4 by 4 inventory sprite atlas for FREEBORN, a painted industrial-noir estuary RPG. Exactly 16 equally sized square cells in a precise 4x4 grid, no outer margin, no visible grid lines, no labels or lettering. Each cell has the same flat very dark charcoal background (#1b1a19), one complete centered subject with generous 12% padding so no subject crosses a cell. Painterly oil/gouache fantasy trading-card realism, tactile wet scales, rust, tarnished brass, bone, restrained amber lamps, slate blue, muted violet; avoid green and cute cartoon styling. Order left to right top to bottom is mandatory. Row 1: (1) compact collapsed telescopic fishing rod with reel and tied hooks, an entire fishing kit bundled to fit one small pouch; (2) open rusted bait tin of pink worms; (3) small silvery sprat; (4) translucent bottle-shaped fish with a swallowed bottle cap. Row 2: (5) pale eel with several small singing mouths along its neck; (6) flat skate whose skin resembles delicately stitched patches; (7) fish with moth wings for fins; (8) long pike with an amber lantern-like organ under its jaw. Row 3: (9) organic smelt with tiny tarnished clockwork plates visible through its flank; (10) crab inhabiting a cracked porcelain teacup; (11) dark flat sole with a lace-like widow's veil fin; (12) short thumb-shaped fleshy fish with a circular golden dorsal fin, absurd but biologically convincing. Row 4: (13) tiny fish wearing a crown-shaped crest of rusty gutter wire; (14) ray folded like a damaged black umbrella; (15) long gar with tangled wire teeth; (16) ancient sturgeon with a soft warm light shining beneath its bony plates. Strange, witty, slightly unsettling catches, no gore. Cohesive art quality, clear silhouettes at small inventory size. This is a single production atlas, not a mockup of a game screen.
scenePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 16:9 full-scene fishing backdrop for FREEBORN industrial noir RPG. First-person quiet view from the end of a rain-soaked wooden estuary jetty, old rope and a small brass tackle case in lower corners, dark rippling water across the central and lower frame, rusted industrial pilings, far ruined factories and low reeds under mist. A slender extended fishing rod enters from lower right and line arcs toward a small bone-white and amber bobber near the center. Painterly trading-card-quality oil illustration with textured brushwork; charcoal, bone, rust, warm amber, slate blue, restrained violet, no green wash. Still and atmospheric, strange shadows of fish deep below without obvious monsters. No people, no text, no logos, no UI or borders. Leave the middle water visually calm so a game can overlay a moving bobber and timing bar. Mature industrial fantasy, cinematic low evening light.
